page_title: EVE 2-2 TOT | Everton v Tottenham Hotspur 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) sees a yellow card from Michael Oliver after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+7' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Everton players have a reason to celebrate!
90+6' Wait! Referee Michael Oliver has indicated he is going to review the Everton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+4' 2 - 2 The ball is whipped in from the free kick and finds the head of Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton), who rises and produces an amazing header inside the right post.
90+4' Sean Dyche (Everton) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+1' James Garner (Everton) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg did his best and is replaced by Radu Dragusin (Tottenham).

88' Chermiti (Everton) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
86' Here is a change. Timo Werner is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Oliver Skipp (Tottenham).
86' We are about to witness a substitution. Bryan Gil (Tottenham) is replacing James Maddison.
85' That will be all from Dwight McNeil who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lewis Dobbin (Everton).
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Beto (Everton) coming on for Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
84' The resulting set piece from Everton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Ashley Young and he is replaced by Chermiti (Everton).
78' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Seamus Coleman (Everton) comes onto the pitch for Ben Godfrey.
73' Richarlison (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
70' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Richarlison (Tottenham) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Jordan Pickford easily catches the ball.
69' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
68' The attendance for today's match is 39321.
68' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle.
67' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
66' James Maddison (Tottenham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rodrigo Bentancur will be replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
64' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Brennan Johnson is replaced by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
60' Ben Godfrey (Everton) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Michael Oliver lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
59' Tottenham take a short corner kick.

59' James Maddison (Tottenham) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Jordan Pickford sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
56' Richarlison (Tottenham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
55' The game is interrupted now, Richarlison (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' Timo Werner (Tottenham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
54' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham).

53' Jack Harrison (Everton) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
52' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
52' Tottenham have a corner.
51' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

51' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Jordan Pickford. Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.
47' Dwight McNeil (Everton) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Michael Oliver has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' James Garner (Everton) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
45+4' Michael Oliver blows for a foul after Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45+3' Everton fail to score from a corner as Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) leaps to collect the ball.
45+2' A header by Ben Godfrey (Everton) from very close range goes straight at Guglielmo Vicario, who makes a nice save.
45+2' Everton force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' Dwight McNeil (Everton) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
41' 1 - 2 Richarlison (Tottenham) struck from medium range, curling the ball into the top right corner. What a hit! Pure magic.
39' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and Michael Oliver signals a foul. Everton win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
34' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Ben Godfrey (Everton) is adjudged offside.
31' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Michael Oliver signals that the goal stands! The Everton players celebrate.
31' Everton score a goal, but referee Michael Oliver has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
30' 1 - 1 Jack Harrison (Everton) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 1:1.
30' The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
28' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
26' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
26' It will be a corner kick for Everton.
24' Richarlison (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Everton get a free kick.
23' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
20' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is flagged for offside.
18' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Michael Oliver stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
16' A player from Everton commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
16' Everton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

15' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Oliver blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Everton.
14' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Richarlison (Tottenham), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
12' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham).
10' The resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

9' James Maddison (Tottenham) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Jordan Pickford thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
8' It's a throw-in for Tottenham.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Destiny Udogie sets up Richarlison (Tottenham) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the roof of the net. 0:1.
3' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Everton will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Oliver.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
